dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Alright, this fruit should be enough to keep that little puffin fed.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Let's head home, Ina.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: I said we shouldn't have picked so much, there's no way one little puffin can eat all this.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Erm... In that case, how about we help it out?

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Look, with that injury, it probably doesn't have much appetite.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: But with us here, maybe we can encourage it to eat a little more... We might speed up its recovery.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: When did you become an expert on looking after animals?

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Then again, I guess you're right. While Granny Sarakka's busy, it's up to us to look after it...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Even though we can't understand what it's saying, it still seems to enjoy having us around.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Haha, it keeps jumping up onto my head. Look how messy my hair is!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: From the looks of it, I'm guessing you found it.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Yeah! That deer led us into a forest, and there were so many puffins in there!

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: And then, one of them flew onto my head, before nestling into my arms!

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: I don't know how, but I recognized it straight away — it was the puffin I rescued.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Kari was grinning like an idiot chasing that little thing around and around. Hmph, no sense of decorum whatsoever...

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: What about you? When those puffins landed on you, you totally froze up!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Huh!? If I'd moved, they'd have all fallen off! I was thinking about their safety.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Ina... they're birds.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Uhm... Birds... Birds can fall off things too, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The important thing is that you had fun.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: We sure did... If anything, I feel like we didn't play enough. Sure would be nice if it'd come visit me when it's better...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Hey, Granny Sarakka told us that we should be satisfied with what we have. If you do nothing but play all day, just wait and see what your parents say.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Alright, I was just saying... You're always so serious.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: #Bye-bye, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Alright, Kari, but once we've finished playing, we need to study!

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Oh, not again...

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Hey there, lil' deer. Want some Midsommar Berries? I just picked these.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Oop, and they're all gone... Guess it really did like 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: #Hey there, {NICKNAME}! We're... uh, on an outing!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: And we meet this deer on our trip. It's super cute!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: #Hey, little deer, can {NICKNAME}, Kari, and I touch you? If you're okay with it... just nod.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Kari! It really can hear what I say! Lauma's right, deer really are clever!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hehehe, there, there, that's a good deer!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: It's coming closer. That's so cute... Hehe. Here you go, have these Lakkaberries too. Eat them slowly now...

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I could understand animal speech just like Lauma can.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: If I could do that, I wouldn't ever have to sit by myself and just... do nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Come on, Kari. Didn't I say I'd play with you all day tomorrow? I've even prepared a ton of toys. It'll be great.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Thank you. But I... still get scared when I sleep alone at night...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Oh yeah. Didn't we pick up an injured puffin the other day? Didn't your parents let you keep it at home?

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Yeah, but its injury has already healed. Granny Sarakka said that nature is an animal's true home, and that keeping it indoors all day might do it harm.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: But I... couldn't bear to see it leave, so I left it over there. I thought that if it didn't fly away, then, y'know, maybe it wanted to stay and be my friend...

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: But then, when I woke up, it was gone.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Ah... Come on, don't be sad. Maybe that little puffin just... went to its parents to tell them it's well. Maybe it'll come back to see you once it gets permission to.

response.speaker: Ina
response.text: See? That puffin could be one of its family members, for all we know.

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: But we don't, Ina. I'm not Miss Lauma. All puffins look the same to me...

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: There's no way I could tell them apart unless they could talk...

response.speaker: Ina
response.text: But see, they're all puffins, right? I'm sure they know each other, so let's just ask it to help us find that little puffin.

response.speaker: Ina
response.text: Here, take some Midsommar Berries and go feed it.

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: O... Okay. Well... Please, Mister Puffin... or Miss Puffin... if you know the little puffin who was staying at my place...

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: Ugh, I'm getting all turned around now, aren't I...

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: Still! I miss that puffin a lot. If you know it, could you ask it to come back and see me?

response.speaker: Ina
response.text: No response... Did it not like these berries? I can go fetch a different kind. Just a moment.

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: Hey, don't fly away! Please don't go! I still have something to tell you!

choices.text: For all you know, they might just know each other.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Columbina</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Maybe I can try to help you with that.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Hmm...? Miss, you are...

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: ...Ah! Lauma told us before, you're the one they call Kuutar...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Hey, Miss Lauma said her name is Columbina, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Oh... Oh right! I remember now...

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: (B—But... isn't she our Moon Goddess!?)

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Umm... you don't have to trouble yourself, Lady Kuu— uh, Miss Columbina... You must be just as busy as Lauma...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: No. I am not. Lauma handles everything.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You want to know how the little puffin you looked after is doing, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Pardon me... Do you know the little puffin Ina and Kari were looking after before?

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Friend, friend! Know, yes! At home! Too long away, danger, danger!)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Papa, Mama, worried. Papa, Mama, stopped it from leaving!)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Your guess is right. The little puffin is currently stuck at home, getting an earful from its parents for being away for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Wow, you're pretty smart, Ina!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Hehe, I've read a lot of books, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Friend, good! Friend, want to see! Come to home, hurry to home!)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...This puffin says that your friend also misses you.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: It can't go outside right now, but you could... go be its guests instead?

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Huh? Could we? But I don't even know where it lives...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: And if we're out of doors for too long, we'll be the ones getting scolded by our parents...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: It's all right. I know some other friends who might lend a hand too.

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (Lady Moon Goddess. Allow me to escort the two children. It is not far to go from here — a round trip shall not even take half a day.)

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (It is no ill deed to help old friends meet again.)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (I'll lead the way! Lead the way! I fly high! I know the shortcuts!)

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: What are they saying, Miss Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: This puffin is willing to take you to see your friend, and this deer wishes to escort you there and back again.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Ohh, that's... that's great! Thank you! And thank you, too!

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Easy-peasy, leave it to me-see!)

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (Mmm. Of wholesome heart and polite, these children are. Lady Columbina, they shall be safe with us.)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Then I leave it to you. Lauma keeps many fruits on her table. When you return, I'll share some with you. They're quite sweet.

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (You are most welcome, Lady Moon Goddess. There is no need for such decorum when aiding family.)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (I wanna eat fruit! So does he! He wants 'em too, but he won't say!)

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Are we... supposed to get on?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes. You can walk with them if you like, but it's a long way. Better to ride.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Got it, thank you! Come on, Kari, up we go.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Ina and Kari climb atop the Rimehorn Deer's back. Afterward, the puffin flies up, with the deer following closely. Very quickly, the two people and two animals disappear from sight...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...I wonder what it feels like to ride on a Rimehorn Deer like that. Maybe... I should try it sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps we might find someone who could help them communicate...)

dialogues.speaker: Kari & Ina
dialogues.text: (Kari and Ina are trying their best to communicate with the puffin, but it's not working...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps if we had someone here who could understand animal speech...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (We could try asking <color=#FFCC33FF>Lauma</color> to help out...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Let's go first...)

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: No response... Did it not like these berries? I can go fetch a different kind. Just a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Hey, don't fly away! Please don't go! I still have something to tell you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Lauma</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Ina, Kari, allow me to pass the message on your behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: M—Miss Lauma!

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Ah... Well... we wouldn't wanna trouble you. Granny Sarakka says you're always busy, so it'd be best not to disturb you with small stuff like this...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I do happen to be free at the moment. And yes, I did hear what you said.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: In which case, allow me to ask this puffin if it recognizes your friend.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Dear child. Do you know the little puffin Ina and Kari took care of previously?

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Friend, friend! Know, yes! At home! Too long away, danger, danger!)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Papa, Mama, worried. Papa, Mama, stopped it from leaving!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...I see. Ina, it seems your deduction was spot on.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Your friend is currently stuck at home, getting an earful from its parents for being away for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Wow, you're pretty smart, Ina!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Hehe, I do read a lot of books normally, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Friend, good! Friend, want to see! Come to home, hurry to home!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Hmm? It seems... this puffin says that your friend also misses you.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: It can't go outside right now, but you could... go be its guests instead?

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Huh? Could we? But I don't even know where it lives...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: And if we're out of doors for too long, we'll be the ones getting scolded by our parents...

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (Lady Lauma. Allow me to escort the two children. It is not far to go from here — a round trip shall not even take half a day.)

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (It is no ill deed to help old friends meet again.)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (I'll lead the way! Lead the way! I fly high! I know the shortcuts!)

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: What are they saying, Lauma?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: It would seem that your previous concerns have been resolved.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: This puffin is willing to take you to see your friend, and this deer wishes to escort you there and back again.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Wow? Really? Is that true, Miss Lauma, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Of course it is. Have I ever lied to you?

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Ohh, that's... that's great! Thank you! And thank you, too!

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Easy-peasy, leave it to me-see!)

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (Mmm. Of wholesome heart and polite, these children are. Lady Lauma, they shall be safe with us.)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I shall be counting on you two, then. Please come to the library once your task is done. I have a gift for you.

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (You are most welcome, Lady Lauma. There is no need for such decorum when aiding family.)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (I wanna eat fruit! So does he! He wants 'em too, but he won't say!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hehe. In that case, I shall prepare the sweetest of fruits for you both.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Come, Ina, Kari. When you hop on, be sure to sit tight.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Don't look up as you pass through the woods, and don't reach out your hands. Just stay low and stay seated, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Ina & Kari
dialogues.text: Okay, Miss Lauma!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Ina and Kari climb atop the Rimehorn Deer's back. Afterward, the puffin begins flying, with the deer following closely. Very quickly, the two people and two animals disappear from sight...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I hope you have a wonderful time, dear children.
